explain.en: Packages conda has downloaded. Files are shared with your environments, so removing them by hand can break them; Hoardless only shows conda's own command. That command cleans all of conda's package caches, not just this folder, so it may free more than shown here. Run it with --dry-run first to preview.
explain.zh: conda 下载过的包。这些文件和你的 Python 环境共用，手动删可能把环境弄坏，所以这里只给出 conda 自带的清理命令。这条命令会清理 conda 所有的包缓存，不只这个文件夹，腾出的空间可能比这里显示的多。可以先加 --dry-run 预览一下。

notes: The main cache is <root_prefix>/pkgs, usually outside the home folder (/opt/anaconda3, Homebrew Caskroom) and so out of scope until resolvers exist. mamba/micromamba (~/micromamba/pkgs, ~/.mamba/pkgs) need their own rule with micromamba's command. CONDA_PKGS_DIRS can hold several paths; the separator is not documented, so treat it as one path until verified.
